title: `sp explain` shows owner, due date and OVERDUE from the tracker, regressions, the collector's own note, whether a person is needed, the private evidence path and an exception snippet expiring in 90 days

regex: ^where: host:web-1   area: host - the machine itself \(updates, firewall, disk\)$
^status: open   first seen 2026-11-01   last seen 2026-11-01   came back 2x$
^If you decide to accept the risk instead \(a human decision with an end date\), add to \S*/data/exceptions\.yaml:$

^  exceptions:
    3594b15d6a9f:
      approved_by: <your name>
      reason: <why this is acceptable for now>
      expires: '({date:+7776000}|{date:+7779600})'$
